card.name: Words just before an increase or change
card.fires_on: Words right where a rise or change is about to be stated, such as 'more', 'increased', 'enhance' or 'becoming'. It appears in drug-interaction text and in general web text.

modes.label: Comparative before a result
modes.description: 'more' or 'now' sits where a rise or shift in amount or habit is about to be described.
modes.example: you’re<< more>> likely to keep up with those activities.

modes.label: Interaction effect wording
modes.description: Words like 'enhance', 'increased' or 'each' appear in drug-interaction sentences, just before the thing that is raised or changed.
modes.example: Diuretic-induced hypokalemia may<< enhance>> neuromuscular blocking effects of cur

card.writes: It suppresses Chinese and English words for 'increase' and 'change', so the model is less likely to repeat that idea next.
card.plain: It fires on words that already signal something is going up or changing, just before the thing affected is named.
